notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native timed-save FQR active-callback resignation guard. An adapter supplies the provider, FOM, endpoint, and logical-time implementation. With HLA_EVOKED callbacks, a regulating owner requests a timed save at time 5; a constrained member requests FQR(6). The owner receives its time-5 grant before save initiation; the constrained member receives Initiate Federate Save before Flush Queue Grant(6). Resignation within that active callback is rejected with CallNotAllowedFromWithinCallback. Both members complete the save and receive Federation Saved. Direct traceability is limited to the seven pinned requirement-section pairs in clauses 4.12, 4.19, 4.19.6, 4.20, and 4.23. The C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. No immediate-callback, late-arrival FQR cutoff, interoperability, or conformance claim.
